validation_statement: Explicit synthetic and offline validation only. No real Antarctic operational telemetry used.
limitations: Evaluated exclusively on synthetic normal and anomaly patterns generated for Maitri station. Real-world physical noise and unexpected failure modes may differ.

normal_warmup.behavior: Steps 1 to 29 return INSUFFICIENT_DATA with null anomaly_score and anomaly_type.

normal_scored_inference.behavior: Step 30 scored successfully with status=NORMAL and finite score=0.002237.

missing_data.behavior: Missing/None value routes to MISSING_DATA, clears rolling buffer, returns null score.

duplicate_telemetry.behavior: Duplicate timestamp raises DuplicateTelemetryError without advancing or duplicating buffer.

out_of_order_telemetry.behavior: Older timestamp raises StaleTelemetryError without corrupting chronological sequence.

non_finite_values.behavior: NaN, +inf, and -inf never reach LSTM; safely routed to MISSING_DATA with cleared buffer.

sensor_isolation.behavior: Each sensor maintains independent rolling deque; interleaved records do not cross-contaminate.

reset_behavior.behavior: reset_sensor clears only the specified sensor; reset_all clears all sensor histories.

determinism.behavior: Identical inputs across fresh service instances yield bit-for-bit identical inference dictionaries.

bounded_buffer.behavior: Rolling history bounded strictly to 30 steps with collections.deque(maxlen=30).
